Package com.egradx.events.kafka

Class EgradxKafkaEventTransport

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.events.kafka.EgradxKafkaEventTransport
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxEventTransport, AutoCloseable
public class EgradxKafkaEventTransport extends Object implements EgradxEventTransport
Events over Kafka, for volumes RabbitMQ is not meant for.
  • Each type is a topic of its own (with an optional prefix). The event's subject is the key, so one subject's events of one type share a partition and are read in the order they were sent. That is not always the order they were published in: retries, and several relays, can send them in another. Where order matters, carry a sequence in the data and let handlers cope with an older event arriving late.
  • A service consumes as a consumer group of its own, so each event reaches one of its instances.
  • A handler that keeps failing is retried with backoff; then the record goes to the dead-letter topic <topic>.DLT, as it came, with Spring's kafka_dlt-* headers saying where from and why. So does a record that is not an event. Nothing is skipped silently: the dead-letter topic is where to look, and from where a record can be published again.
